glosses.notes: A person who belongs to a group, team, organization, or committee; it refers to belonging to the group, not just showing up once.

examples.sentence: 每个成员都得把自己负责的部分准备好。
项目组来了两位新成员，大家先花时间互相认识。
讨论这个问题的时候，几个成员的意见并不一样。

example_translations.translation: Each member has to get the part they are responsible for ready.
Two new members joined the project team, so everyone first spent some time getting to know one another.
When discussing this issue, several members did not have the same opinion.

glosses.notes: Used when something freezes because of cold, when someone freezes food, or when part of the body becomes painfully cold or numb.

examples.sentence: 夜里太冷，放在外面的水早上已经冻上了。
这些鱼先冻起来，周末家里人来了一起吃。
我在外面等了半天，手都快冻得没有感觉了。

example_translations.translation: It was so cold at night that the water left outside had frozen over by morning.
Freeze these fish first, and we'll eat them together when the family comes over this weekend.
I waited outside for a long time, and my hands were almost numb from the cold.

glosses.notes: To hold or support a person or thing by hand so it does not fall; often used when helping someone stand, walk, or move carefully.

examples.sentence: 奶奶起身的时候，我赶紧过去扶了她一把。
路太滑，他只好扶着墙慢慢往前走。
她刚做完手术，下楼的时候一直有人扶着她。

example_translations.translation: When Grandma got up, I quickly went over and gave her a supporting hand.
The road was too slippery, so he had to hold onto the wall and move forward slowly.
She had just had surgery, so someone was supporting her the whole time while she went downstairs.

secondary_glosses: if it were the case that
glosses.notes: A somewhat more formal way to introduce a hypothetical condition or imagined situation, similar to 如果 but less everyday in tone.

examples.sentence: 假如明天还下雨，活动就得改到室内了。
假如你来负责这个项目，你会先解决哪个问题？
假如没有地图，我们可能到天黑也找不到那里。

example_translations.translation: If it still rains tomorrow, the activity will have to be moved indoors.
Suppose you were in charge of this project; which problem would you solve first?
If we didn't have a map, we might not find that place even by nightfall.

glosses.notes: Casual denim pants. In normal use, 牛仔裤 refers to jeans as an item of clothing, often in contexts like fit, style, comfort, or everyday wear.

examples.sentence: 我试了几条裤子，还是这条牛仔裤最合身。
他平时上班不穿牛仔裤，只有周末才会穿。
旅行的时候穿牛仔裤虽然方便，但下雨以后不容易干。

example_translations.translation: I tried on several pairs of pants, but this pair of jeans still fits best.
He doesn't wear jeans to work; he only wears them on weekends.
Wearing jeans while traveling is convenient, but after it rains they are not easy to dry.

glosses.notes: 配 often means one thing goes well with another, especially clothes, colors, or food. In patterns like 很配, it means two things look right together or are well-matched.

examples.sentence: 这双白鞋配那条蓝裙子，确实很好看。
这条围巾虽然简单，但很配她那件大衣。
热汤配米饭，冬天吃起来特别舒服。

example_translations.translation: These white shoes really go well with that blue dress.
Although this scarf is simple, it matches that coat of hers very well.
Hot soup goes well with rice and feels especially comforting in winter.

glosses.notes: Can describe literal forward movement or figurative progress. It usually suggests continuing ahead instead of stopping.

examples.sentence: 队伍在大雨里慢慢前进，谁也没有停下来。
只要方向没有错，我们就继续前进。
技术一直在前进，老办法已经不够用了。

example_translations.translation: The group kept moving forward slowly in the heavy rain, and no one stopped.
As long as the direction is right, we'll keep moving forward.
Technology keeps advancing, and the old methods are no longer enough.

glosses.notes: A slightly more formal way to say now or nowadays, often when comparing the present with the past.

examples.sentence: 如今在网上买东西，比以前方便得多。
如今不少老人也会用手机付钱了。
她如今一个人住，很多事都得自己决定。

example_translations.translation: Nowadays buying things online is much more convenient than before.
Nowadays quite a few older people can also pay with their phones.
She lives on her own now, and she has to make many decisions herself.

glosses.notes: For things, 晒 means putting them in the sun so they dry or air out. In 晒太阳, it means sitting in the sun yourself.

examples.sentence: 天气一放晴，奶奶就把被子拿到阳台上去晒。
这些衣服晒了一下午，太阳下山前应该能干。
冬天坐在窗边晒太阳，连看书都觉得舒服。

example_translations.translation: As soon as the weather cleared up, Grandma took the quilt out onto the balcony to dry in the sun.
These clothes have been drying in the sun all afternoon, so they should be dry before sunset.
In winter, sitting by the window in the sun makes even reading feel pleasant.

glosses.notes: Describes speech, writing, pictures, expressions, or performances that feel clear, lively, and easy to picture in your mind.

examples.sentence: 她只用了几个小细节，就把那个人写得很生动。
画里孩子的表情很生动，看的人也会想笑。
他说得太生动了，我一下就想起了小时候。

example_translations.translation: With just a few small details, she made that person come vividly to life in her writing.
The child's expression in the picture is very lifelike, and it makes viewers want to smile too.
He described it so vividly that I immediately thought of my childhood.

glosses.notes: Refers to one of the twelve traditional zodiac animals linked to a person's birth year, such as rat, ox, tiger, or rabbit.

examples.sentence: 别人一问我的生肖，我总得先想一下自己属什么。
她和我生肖一样，所以每次过年都爱买一样的小东西。
过年的时候，商店里常能看到按生肖做的小礼物。

example_translations.translation: Whenever someone asks my Chinese zodiac sign, I always have to think for a moment about which animal year I was born in.
She has the same zodiac sign as I do, so every New Year we both like buying the same little things.
During New Year, you can often see small gifts in shops made according to the zodiac animals.

glosses.notes: As a verb, 喂 means giving food, drink, or medicine to a person or animal. As an interjection, it is the very common hello? used when starting or answering a phone call, and sometimes hey to get attention.

examples.sentence: 奶奶每天一早都去院子里喂鸡，鸡一看见她就围过来。
孩子还没完全退烧，妈妈只好一口一口地喂他喝水。
喂，你先别挂电话，我还有一句话没说完。

example_translations.translation: Every morning Grandma goes into the yard to feed the chickens, and they crowd around her as soon as they see her.
The child still hasn't fully recovered from the fever, so his mother has to give him water one mouthful at a time.
Hello, don't hang up yet; I still have one more thing to say.
